intro.en: The subjunctive for whatever, wherever and however, and three more ways of saying that an obstacle does not matter.

sea como sea.en: be that as it may; one way or another

aun.nota: Without an accent: even. With an accent, aún means still.

le guste o no.en: whether he likes it or not

quieras o no.en: whether you like it or not

texto.en:
You know that a relative clause about something unknown takes the subjunctive: busco un piso que **tenga** luz. The same logic gives Spanish its way of saying -ever.

- Siéntate **donde quieras**. (wherever)
- Hazlo **como quieras**. (however)
- Ven **cuando puedas**. (whenever)
- Come **lo que quieras**. (whatever)
- **Quien quiera** venir, que venga. (whoever)
- **El que llegue** primero, que avise.

With the indicative, the same sentences talk about something known: Me senté **donde quise**. Hazlo **como dice** el manual.

**The doubled formula.** Verb in the subjunctive + relative + the same verb:

- **Pase lo que pase**, te llamaré.
- **Digan lo que digan**, no pienso cambiar.
- **Vayas donde vayas**, encontrarás a un español.
- **Sea como sea**, hay que terminarlo hoy.
- **Cueste lo que cueste.**
- **Hagas lo que hagas**, no abras esa puerta.

**Whether or not.** Two short forms with the subjunctive: **quieras o no**, **le guste o no**, **llueva o no llueva**.

And one with the indicative: **Tanto si llueve como si** hace sol, iremos.

**Even if.** **Incluso si** takes the same tenses as si: **incluso si llueve**, iré; **incluso si lloviera**, iría. **Aun** + gerund means the same: **aun sabiendo** la verdad, calló.

**Aun** and **aún.** Without an accent, even: **aun así** (even so). With an accent, still: **aún** no ha llegado.

**However much.** **Por muy** cansado **que esté**, siempre nos ayuda. **Por mucho que** insistas, no lo haré.

frases.es: Mi abuelo ha decidido, a sus ochenta y cinco años, que va a seguir viviendo solo, digan lo que digan sus hijos.
frases.en: My grandfather has decided, at the age of eighty-five, that he is going to go on living alone, whatever his children say.
analisis: a sus ochenta y cinco años
que va a seguir viviendo solo

frases.es: Le han ofrecido que elija la casa que quiera y que se instale donde prefiera.
frases.en: They have offered to let him choose whichever house he wants and settle wherever he prefers.

frases.es: Él contesta que, tanto si se lo piden por las buenas como si se lo piden por las malas, no piensa moverse.
frases.en: He replies that, whether they ask him nicely or nastily, he has no intention of moving.
analisis: tanto si se lo piden por las buenas
como si se lo piden por las malas

frases.es: Por muy cabezota que sea, hay que reconocer que se las arregla bastante bien.
frases.en: However stubborn he may be, it must be admitted that he manages pretty well.

frases.es: Cocina lo que le apetece, come cuando tiene hambre y recibe a quien quiera visitarlo.
frases.en: He cooks what he fancies, eats when he is hungry and receives whoever wants to visit him.

frases.es: Incluso si un día se cayera, dice, preferiría eso a que lo trataran como a un niño.
frases.en: Even if one day he fell, he says, he would prefer that to being treated like a child.
analisis: Incluso si un día se cayera

frases.es: Aun así, nos turnamos para llamarlo cada noche, le guste o no.
frases.en: Even so, we take turns to phone him every night, whether he likes it or not.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what does the grandfather refuse to do?

Receive visitors.en: He receives whoever wants to visit.

pregunta.en: Complete: whatever happens, I'll call you.

Pase.en: The doubled formula repeats the same verb in the subjunctive.

Pasa.en: Both verbs are in the subjunctive.

Pasará.en: Both verbs are in the subjunctive.

quieras.en: An unknown place takes the subjunctive.

quieres.en: With the indicative it would be a place already chosen.

pregunta.en: Complete: whether it rains or it's sunny, we'll go.

bloques.frase: Tanto si ___ como si hace sol, iremos.

llueve.en: Tanto si… como si… takes the indicative.

llueva.en: After si, never the present subjunctive.

pregunta.en: Aun así, lo hizo. Here aun means…

still.en: That is aún, with an accent.

bloques.frase: Le guste o no, tendrá que aceptarlo.

texto.en: Whether he likes it or not, he will have to accept it.
He likes it or he doesn't, he must accept.

explicacion.en: The subjunctive pair means whether… or not.

texto.en: If he doesn't like it, he won't accept it.

explicacion.en: The sentence says he will have to accept it anyway.

bloques.frase: Vayas donde vayas, siempre encontrarás a alguien

traduccion.en: Wherever you go, you will always find someone.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write about a decision you will stick to whatever happens and whatever people say.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give a guest complete freedom aloud: sit where you like, eat what you like, come when you can. Then talk about what you will do whether you like it or not.
